source_article_clinical_replicate_statem: Clinical samples of patients suffering from acetaminophen-induced acute liver failure and healthy liver samples: n=3 biological replicates for ALF samples and n=2 biological replicates for healthy liver.
limitations: A numeric match supports a transformation but does not prove the historical software or selection process.
Current downloaded GPL570 annotation is used; historical annotation version is unconfirmed.
Equal-variance t tests on linear values are checked only to trace the original p column, not recommended for the revision.
Sample independence is reported by the source publication; individual donor IDs/covariates are not established by numeric matching.
The historical selection intent/software, historical annotation version, original run settings and original cluster/enrichment results remain unconfirmed.
